name: what-if-history
description: What If History Changed? vertical video kit (Remotion + Three.js)

scripts.render:char: remotion still BaseTurnaround out/char/base-turnaround.png && remotion still BaseVariants out/char/base-variants.png && remotion still HandPoses out/char/hand-poses.png && remotion still RigTest out/char/rig-test.png && remotion still Expressions out/char/expressions.png && remotion still FaceParts out/char/face-parts.png && remotion still Headgear out/char/headgear.png && remotion still Costumes out/char/costumes.png && remotion still Props out/char/props.png && remotion render FaceTalkTest out/char/face-talk-test.mp4 && remotion render CostumeTurntable out/char/costume-turntable.mp4 && remotion still Cast out/char/cast.png && remotion render CrowdDemo out/char/crowd-demo.mp4
scripts.render:motion: remotion render Showreel out/motion/showreel.mp4 && remotion render ActionsGrid out/motion/actions-grid.mp4
scripts.render:sets: for s in GLOBE MAP_REGION ANCIENT_CITY THRONE_ROOM BATTLEFIELD LIBRARY PORT MEDIEVAL_VILLAGE WORKSHOP MODERN_CITY JUNGLE_PREHISTORIC BEACH; do remotion still SetPreview out/sets/$s.png --frame=45 --props="{\"set\":\"$s\"}"; done && remotion render GlobeDemo out/sets/globe-demo.mp4
